theme.InstallMessageOptions: Shigar da FuzeVPN a wannan kwamfuta.
theme.HelpText: /install, /repair, /uninstall: shigarwa, gyarawa, cirewa. /quiet: yanayin shiru. /norestart: kar a sake kunnawa. DesktopShortcut=1: gajeriyar hanya a tebur. InstallFolder="D:\Applications\FuzeVPN": babban fayil na farko. Sabuntawa na riƙe babban fayil ɗin da aka shigar.
theme.OptionsLocationLabel: Babban fayil na shigarwa (Windows na kare shi)
theme.SuccessUninstallRestartText: Sake kunnawa don kammala cire shigarwa.
theme.FailureHyperlinkLogText: An katse aikin. Duba kundin bayanai, gyara matsalar, sannan a sake gwadawa.
theme.FilesInUseTitle: Fayilolin da ake amfani da su
theme.FilesInUseLabel: Rufe waɗannan manhajoji, sannan a sake gwadawa.
theme.PreserveInstallFolder: Ana riƙe babban fayil ɗin da yake akwai yayin sabuntawa. Don matsar da manhajar yadda kuke so, yi amfani da ma'ajiyar da ake iya ɗauka.
msi.Downgrade: An riga an shigar da sabuwar sigar FuzeVPN.
msi.WindowsX64: Wannan mai shigarwa yana buƙatar Windows {Architecture}. Zaɓi kunshin da ya dace da kwamfutarka.
msi.Rollback: Dole ne a kunna mayar da canje-canje na Windows Installer don shigarwa ko cire FuzeVPN lafiya.
msi.ServiceDescription: Yana sarrafa ramukan WireGuard da OpenVPN na FuzeVPN kawai.
native.1: An shigar da FuzeVPN, amma sabis ɗinsa bai tabbatar da sake kunnawa ba. Sake shigarwa don gyara manhajar.
native.2: Ba a iya tabbatar da sigar Windows ko tsarin kwamfutar ba. Duba kundin bayanan shigarwa.
native.3: FuzeVPN yana buƙatar Windows 10 ko Windows 11.
native.4: Wannan mai shigarwa yana buƙatar Windows {Architecture}. Zaɓi kunshin da ya dace da kwamfutarka.
native.5: Dole ne a kunna mayar da canje-canje na Windows Installer kafin kowane aikin kula da FuzeVPN.
native.6: Zaɓi cikakkiyar hanyar babban fayil na cikin kwamfuta don shigar da FuzeVPN.
native.7: An riga an shigar da sabuwar siga, ko kuma ba a iya tabbatar da sigarta ba.
native.8: Ba a iya shirya aikin kulawa ba.
native.9: Binciken siga ko babban fayil ya gaza.
native.10: VPN bai tabbatar da cewa ya tsaya ba. An katse shigarwa ba tare da maye gurbin fayilolin ba.
native.11: Rufe FuzeVPN da mai taimakon sabunta shi, sannan a sake shigarwa. Ba a tilasta dakatar da wani tsari ba.
native.12: Ba a iya dakatar da VPN lafiya ba.
native.13: Ba a iya kammala aikin kulawa ba. Sake shigarwa don gyara FuzeVPN.
native.14: Mayar da canje-canje yana riƙe toshewar hanyar sadarwa ta aikin kulawa; sake gudanar da shigarwa don gyarawa.
theme.SuccessOpenApp: Buɗe FuzeVPN daga menu na Fara. An riƙe zaɓuɓɓukanka na kanka.
